channel.title: Waka Huia
channel.desc: NEW: A proud son of Ng?ti Manawa, war veteran Richard Dargaville, once a soldier for the New Zealand Army, he remains forever a soldier for te ao M?ori. His service reflects not just commitment to a nation, but a deep dedication to whakapapa, identity, and the ongoing struggles and strengths of his wh?nau and wider M?ori communities.
